about: TR2-S5 server geometry: generated by dev/tr2_s5_vectors.sh from the game code. Coordinates in metres, x east, z south (the game frame); angles in radians.

heights.about: ground height on a grid: h(x,z) = bilinear(cm[j*nx+i] / 100), node (i,j) at (x0 + i*step, z0 + j*step); little-endian int16 (centimetres), base64; outside the grid = no ground (WALL fails there anyway)
